name: svgo-sortattrs-rollup-svg-sprite-loader
behavioral_change: svgo v3.0.0 added the `sortAttrs` plugin to `preset-default`, enabled by default to improve gzip compression. `svgo.optimize(code, svgoOptions)` keeps the same signature and throws nothing, but the attributes of every element in the output are reordered. The same release renamed the `cleanupIDs` plugin to `cleanupIds` and replaced the `OptimizeOptions` and `Plugin` types with a built-in `Config` type.
downstream_effect: The downstream project's output has the same bytes in a different attribute order, so whole-file string comparisons against committed target files in tests/index.test.ts fail with only "Expected: true, Received: false". The output also shows TS2305 type errors and `cleanupIDs` configuration warnings pointing at src/index.ts, but these concern the interface components; sortAttrs never appears and the attribute reordering must be discovered by comparing the artifacts.
reference_fix: The reference fix edits src/index.ts in two hunks: it imports `Config` from svgo and derives type aliases from it, and in the `preset-default` overrides renames `cleanupIDs` to `cleanupIds` and adds `sortAttrs: false`.
documented_in: The svgo v3.0.0 release notes (https://github.com/svg/svgo/releases/tag/v3.0.0), "Breaking channges" (sic) Config section, state "Enabled sortAttrs plugin by default to get better gzip compression", show a before/after SVG, and give a complete code block with `sortAttrs: false` in `params.overrides`, which the reference fix matches verbatim; the same section documents the `cleanupIds` rename with a code block and the `Config` type.
